# Research evidence report

How might humidity affect coating adhesion?

Assessment — inconclusive

The hypothesis that humidity affects coating adhesion by reducing water uptake and subsequently decreasing adhesion is supported by the evidence that coating adhesion decreased after exposure to high humidity, with water uptake measured before the adhesion test.

## [S1] Synthetic coating observation

Synthetic observation: Coating adhesion decreased after exposure to high humidity. Water uptake was measured before the adhesion test.
